# GEO report: quay-store **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 40/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points). How it's calculated: low = 12 ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. High = (12 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 48. Both are capped at 40 because of a blocker: `static/robots.txt:5` blocks Googlebot from the whole site (GEO-009). Nothing here depends on things outside the code, so the score has no unknowns. Two problems account for most of the lost points. One is the Googlebot block. The other is that pages are built only in the browser, so crawlers that don't run JavaScript get an empty page. I assumed you want search and AI search tools to find this site, because there's no `geo.config.json`. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking Googlebot in robots.txt - **Why it matters:** Google's crawler is told to stay off every page, including the home page and shop that your sitemap and menu point to. - **Where:** `static/robots.txt:5` - **What the code says:** `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 72 (GEO-009 and GEO-014 become Clear, the cap lifts: 18 ÷ 25). ### 2. Render pages on the server - **Why it matters:** Many crawlers don't run JavaScript. With server rendering off, they receive an empty shell with no title, description, canonical or text. - **Where:** `src/routes/+layout.ts:1` - **What the code says:** `export const ssr = false;` - **Size:** Small. Remove the line, or set `prerender = true` for these static pages. - **Score after this:** 84 if done after item 1 (21 ÷ 25). Alone it stays at 40, because the cap still applies. ### 3. Add `lang` and a real shop description - **Why it matters:** The `lang` attribute tells machines the page language. An empty description gives them nothing to show for `/shop`. - **Where:** `src/app.html:2` and `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3` - **What the code says:** `` and `` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 80 if done after item 1 (20 ÷ 25). With items 1, 2 and 3 together it's 92. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and reachable | Clear | Not run | `static/robots.txt` is valid plain text | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers have the access you intend | Problem | Not run | `static/robots.txt:4-5`, Googlebot `Disallow: /` (site-wide). Training crawlers like GPTBot aren't mentioned. | | GEO-014 | Listed and linked pages are indexable | Problem | Not run | `/` and `/shop` are blocked for Googlebot by `static/robots.txt:5` (0 of 2 clear). `/search` is noindex on purpose and isn't listed or linked, so it's left out. | | GEO-015 | One absolute canonical on your own domain | Clear | Not run | `+page.svelte:4` and `shop/+page.svelte:4` (2 of 2). `https://quay.example` matches the sitemap and robots. | | GEO-003 | Content is in the server's HTML | Problem | Not run | `src/routes/+layout.ts:1`: `export const ssr = false;` (site-wide) | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid and complete | Problem | Not run | `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5`: Product has only `name`. Google documents `offers`, `review` or `aggregateRating` as needed too. | | GEO-011 | Sitemap exists and robots.txt points to it | Clear | Not run | `static/sitemap.xml`, `static/robots.txt:7` | | GEO-012 | Title, description and `lang` | Problem | Not run | `src/app.html:2` has no `lang` (all routes). `shop/+page.svelte:3` has an empty description. | | GEO-016 | Key pages reachable through normal links | Clear | Not run | `src/routes/+layout.svelte:5` uses `` for Home and Shop. See GEO-003 for whether they reach crawlers. | | GEO-017 | Snippet limits don't conflict | Clear | Not run | No page-wide nosnippet. `+layout.svelte:7` has `data-nosnippet` on one element, which is fine. | | GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Clear | Not run | Read the layout and 3 pages. There are no images, links have text, and every page has a title. | | GEO-101 | Mobile app files | Not applicable | Not run | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (information only) | Not applicable | Not run | None present. Not scored. | ## Other problems found None found. ## Worth considering - **Product details in the structured data:** `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5`: `"name":"Bilge pump"`. Adding a price and availability might help machines read what you sell. It also fixes GEO-004. - **Backing up "shipped next day":** `src/routes/+page.svelte:7`: `

Marine parts, shipped next day

`. The only delivery detail is a `data-nosnippet` line at `+layout.svelte:7`. A visible delivery policy page, linked from the nav, would answer the obvious question. - **A page for each product:** `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:9`: `

Bilge pumps, cleats and rope.

`. Each product category or item could have its own page and address, listed in the sitemap. - **Page basics in the shell:** `src/app.html:4`: ``. There's no `viewport` meta tag, and the content isn't inside `
`. - **Home page links onward:** `src/routes/+page.svelte:7` has only a heading. Adding text and links to the shop sections would give readers and crawlers more to follow. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Live-only checks:** whether the listed URLs answer 200, and whether the raw HTML carries your text. A live scan with your URL would confirm these. ## Assumptions - You want search and AI search tools to find this site. - `https://quay.example` is your real domain. It's used consistently, but I couldn't confirm it. - `/search` is deliberately noindex. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
